record.paper_title: Slices of Brownian Sheet: New Results, and Open Problems
record.original_question: Consider the linear parabolic SPDE system ∂u^i/∂t(t,x) = ∂^2 u^i/∂x^2(t,x) + ˆB_i(t,x) with reasonable boundary conditions. Is there a theory of the slices of the solution field u at fixed times t, analogous to the slice theory developed in this paper for Brownian sheets?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 6. Consider the following system of linear parabolic SPDE: ∂ui/∂t (t,x ) = ∂ 2ui/∂x 2 (t,x ) + ˆBi(t,x ), (8.4) with reasonable boundary conditions. Is there an analysis of the “slices” of u along diﬀerent values of t that is analogous to the results of the present paper?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\hat B_1,\hat B_2,\ldots,\hat B_d$ be independent space-time white noises on $[0,\infty)\times[0,1]$, i.e., centered Gaussian generalized random fields with $\mathbb{E}[\hat B_i(t,x)\hat B_j(s,y)]=\delta_{ij}\delta(t-s)\delta(x-y)$. Consider the linear parabolic stochastic PDE system
$$\frac{\partial u^i}{\partial t}(t,x)=\frac{\partial^2 u^i}{\partial x^2}(t,x)+\hat B_i(t,x),\qquad i=1,\ldots,d,$$
on $(t,x)\in(0,\infty)\times(0,1)$, equipped with reasonable boundary conditions (e.g., Dirichlet, Neumann, or periodic) on $\{0,1\}$ and an initial condition $u^i(0,\cdot)=u_0^i(\cdot)$, so that the system has a unique mild (function-valued) solution $u=(u^1,\ldots,u^d):[0,\infty)\times[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}^d$.

For each fixed $t>0$, call the random field $x\mapsto u(t,x)$ the time-$t$ slice of $u$. Develop a theory of these slices analogous to the theory of fixed-coordinate slices $\{B(s,\cdot)\}$ of a $d$-parameter Brownian sheet: in particular, determine the local and global path regularity of $x\mapsto u(t,x)$; classify the Hausdorff dimensions of the level sets, zero sets, multiple-point sets, and self-intersection sets of the slice; describe the polar sets and capacity criteria for hitting probabilities; and identify the dependence of these geometric/quantitative properties on the dimension $d$, the boundary conditions, and the time level $t$.
artifact.category_tag: Stochastic PDEs and Brownian sheet slices
artifact.status_search_result: The problem was posed as an open problem in a 2005/2007 survey on slices of the Brownian sheet. A web search reveals no paper systematically developing a slice theory for the time-$t$ random fields of the stochastic heat equation analogous to the Brownian-sheet slice theory; related progress (e.g., 2024 work on zeros of the Brownian sheet) addresses other open problems from the same list. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Slices of a Brownian Sheet: New Results and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Presents slice theory for the Brownian sheet together with a list of open problems including one on parabolic SPDE slices.
status_evidence.claim: The question of an analogous slice theory for the linear parabolic SPDE system is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Zeros of the Brownian Sheet
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work resolving a different open problem from the same problem list, with no mention of resolving the parabolic SPDE slice question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress addresses other items but not the parabolic SPDE slice analogue.
